I need to maintain a minimum balance of 500 rupees. I use to get an alert messages from bank whenever I do a transactions but not getting any offer message.

I have opened a salary account from HDFC bank. I have been holding this account for more than 5 years. Their service is prompt to the customer. I am having a salary account from State bank of India. I need to hold the minimum balance of Rs. 500. Their Internet banking and mobile app facility is really good. I am using Standard Chartered Bank salary account for 1.5 years .This account is used much frequently and also using net banking service as well as mobile banking service and credit card bill payment and money transfer .customer service is also good and banking service was comfortable .

I am holding a saving account with HDFC bank for more than 2 years. There is no hidden charges in this bank. It is a minimum balance account to maintain of 10K. ACB charges are applicable if I not maintain a minimum amount in account, on monthly basis charge of 1200 rupees.

Last 1 year, i have my salary account from Digi and its a basic account hence i don't get any benefits from this account. There is no minimum balance required. Internet banking facility is really good. Branch response was good but only one branch is available in the entire city.

I am maintaining my savings account in INDIAN BANK for the past 3-4 Years and this is salary cums savings account. Till now there was no issues, its a friendly bank according to my experience. I am using the online service which is very good. Customer service was good.

Opened my salary account with HDFC bank and i have been using this account since 2016. They are not taking any hidden charges. Its good to use the Internet banking and mobile app facility. There is no need of maintaining any minimum balance. In the branch, response was good.
